title: Household Credit and Regulatory Arbitrage: Evidence from Online Marketplace Lending
authors: Fabio Braggion; Alberto Manconi; Haikun Zhu
eligible_reason: Single-onset DiD: treated2013 cities (subject to the November 2013 LTV-cap tightening) vs other cities, event2013 = post-November 2013 (common date). Table 8 uses the March 2015 and September 2015 LTV changes, each a single date in its own sample; Table 9 uses 2005/2013/2015 events separately. No staggered adoption within any regression. Most columns also add time-varying provincial controls, borrower controls, homeowner triple interactions, or IV.
design_notes: mpl.do: Table 2.A reghdfe lamt_grantedpc 1.event2013##1.treated2013, a(mdate cityid mdate##region) (city-month); Table 4 city-month outcomes with/without provincial controls; Tables 5-6, 10 lender-borrower lamount with homeowner splits and lender x month FE; Table 7, 11 borrower-level; Table 8 event15mar/event15sept; Table 9 house prices and NBS credit (event2005/2013/2015); IV versions with ivreghdfe.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One onset per regression (Nov 2013; Mar 2015; Sep 2015; 2005 in separate regressions).
data_files_note: readme.pdf: scraped Renrendai loan/lender data, other platforms' city-month volumes, NBS city-year data; analysis files shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not staggered (single policy date per regression).
